limitations: Vapi SHA256 identifies a credential, not a provider organization. Even same-org key rotation conservatively stops a bound operation pending separately reviewed recovery; a404 under another key is not absence proof.

Removing current VOICE_FALLBACK_TWIML_URL alone does not block detachment when a retained/provider safe bin remains. Missing all safe retained/provider independent fallback evidence remains unresolved by the agreed compatibility contract; missing signing credentials cannot certify a callback route.
Configured/read-back routing and local fake provider results do not prove live caller fallback, carrier deregistration timing, resource billing cessation or customer service delivery.
